name: Joshua Mark
bio: I am a student from The University of Georgia Graduating this December with a Bachelor's Degree of Computer Science and a Certificate of Applied Data Science.

I graduated North Oconee High School Summa Cum Laude (with a GPA > 3.7) in 2022 and scored a 1280 on the SAT. I also dual-enrolled at The University of North Georgia for 2 years and continued my college-education there until transferring to UGA in 2023. Throughout my entire college career I have maintained a GPA greater than 3.7, including earning a 4.0 at UNG, and I have also maintained my status as a recipient of the merit-based Zell-Miller Scholarship the full 4 years as well.

In addition to my major, I also studied Japanese and gained the opportunity to study abroad in Japan at Kyushu University (2024-2025). Because of this, I have gained basic language proficiency in Japanese (JLPT N3), as well as a passion for Japanese culture. After graduation, I fully intend to continue studying Japanese in my pusuit to gain fluency.

I am a hard worker, a slight perfectionist, and I am always dedicated to the task at hand. I enjoy working with and learning from others, and I am always wanting to learn something new. I look forward to hearing back from you, and even if the current postion does not quite work out, please feel free to contact me about another open position you feel I might be a fit for!
